title: YOU ONLY HAVE TO DIE TWICE NOT THRICE

memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. He who overcomes shall not be hurt by the second death." — Revelation 2:11

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
The world fears death as a finality, but for the Christian, death is a three-fold journey. The First Death is the most vital: the death to sin through Baptism. When we are submerged, we are not just performing a ritual; we are burying the person who was a slave to sin. If we do not die this death, we remain "liable" for our own transgressions.
The Second Death is the Natural Death. This is the appointment every human must keep due to our mortal nature. For the forgiven, this is merely a "sleep" or a transition. It is the end of old age, pain, and earthly toil. The Third Death , the Eternal Death is the one we are called to escape. It is the final judgment and separation in hell. 
The First Death is our choice: dying to sin through Baptism. When we surrender our lives to Christ, we bury our old nature. This is the "death" that saves us. The Second Death is the Natural Death the passing of our physical body due to old age or nature. For the believer, this is the final death they will ever experience. Because our sins were already "killed" at the cross and buried in baptism, we escape the Third Death the eternal separation in hell. While the world faces judgment and eternal death, the believer has already finished their dying. We die to sin, we die to the world, and then we wake up in glory.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: "The man who has died to himself has nothing left to fear from the grave."

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, I acknowledge that I am appointed for a natural end, but I thank You that I do not have to face an eternal one. I choose today to die to my pride, my sins, and my past. Let my baptism be a true burial of the old man, and my life be a resurrection of the new. I am no longer answerable to the debt of sin, for Christ has paid it all. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: Don't fear the "thrice." Each death is a shedding of a layer that keeps you from God. When you die to sin, you are finally free to truly live.
